d: Job title: IB Business Management Teacher (High School)

Nexreq is recruiting for a US-curriculum IB World School in Abu Dhabi for the 2026–27 academic year. The school teaches KG to Grade 12, has a diverse international student community, and is authorized for both the IB PYP and the IB Diploma Programme. High school students take either the US High School Diploma (with AP) or the IB Diploma. Classes are small, and the staff work closely together.
q: A degree in Business, Economics or a related subject, plus a teaching license or teaching qualification. A B.Ed in Business is also accepted. The qualification must meet ADEK requirements.
IB DP Business Management experience is strongly preferred. Candidates willing to train will also be considered.
2+ years of teaching experience, ideally at high school level
Ability to teach to US curriculum standards (e.g., AP) in an international school
Professional English fluency. IELTS 6.0 or equivalent may be required for ADEK licensing.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative attitude
Attested qualifications, with UAE equivalency where required
r: Plan and teach IB DP Business Management with clear, challenging objectives and strong differentiation
Combine IB and US curriculum frameworks with ADEK requirements
Give timely, standards-based feedback and use assessment data to guide teaching
Support English language learners and students with additional learning needs
Bring technology and digital citizenship into lessons
Work with colleagues on unit planning and keep families informed
Help with after-school activities (up to 3 periods a week), occasional trips and exam supervision

d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.
Complex General Manager / Regional Director of Engineering

The Complex Director of Engineering (Pre-Opening) is responsible for leading all engineering, technical services, and facilities management activities during the pre-opening, opening, and operational phases of multiple hotels or resorts. The role ensures that all engineering systems, building infrastructure, MEP installations, life safety systems, and back-of-house facilities are delivered to brand standards, local regulations, and operational requirements.

The position acts as the primary liaison between owners, project consultants, contractors, designers, and hotel operations to ensure a seamless transition from construction to hotel operations while establishing an efficient engineering department capable of delivering exceptional guest experiences.
Lead all engineering activities during hotel development and pre-opening.
Represent hotel operations during design reviews and construction meetings.
Review architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), fire & life safety, kitchen, laundry, and HVAC drawings.
Ensure engineering designs meet brand standards, operational efficiency, sustainability goals, and local authority requirements.
Monitor construction progress and identify operational risks.
Coordinate snagging, defect inspections, and handover processes.
Ensure all contractor punch lists are completed before opening.
Participate in testing and commissioning of all building systems.
Develop the Engineering Department structure for multiple properties.
Recruit, train, and onboard engineering team members.
Establish engineering SOPs and preventive maintenance programs.
Develop asset management and lifecycle maintenance strategies.
Ensure compliance with local building regulations and hospitality standards.
Maintain full compliance with Civil Defense requirements.
Implement fire and life safety procedures.
Conduct emergency response planning and drills.
Prepare annual CapEx and OpEx plans.
Manage engineering contracts and service agreements.
Control utility consumption and operating costs.
Support Green Building and ESG initiatives.
Ensure compliance with environmental certifications where applicable.
Manage contractors during construction and defects liability periods.
Ensure service quality and compliance with contractual obligations.
Ensure all engineering systems are operational before opening.
Support trial stays and soft opening.
Ensure operational readiness of guestrooms and public areas.
Manage final acceptance and handover documentation.
Lead engineering teams across multiple hotels.
Coach and develop engineering managers and supervisors.
Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Foster collaboration with Rooms, F&B, Housekeeping, Security, IT, and Finance teams.
